A24 defends AI partnership with Google DeepMind amid fan criticism

Independent studio A24 has defended its new partnership with Google DeepMind, stating its intention to influence AI development for filmmaking. The studio is responding to criticism from fans who accused them of compromising artistic values. A24 emphasized that they aim to be involved in shaping AI tools rather than being excluded from the process.
